entities.name: Substituted cyclopropanecarbonitrile
observations: Substrate: N#C[C@@]1(c2ccccc2)C[C@H]1COCc1ccccc1, an aryl-substituted cyclopropanecarbonitrile with a benzyloxymethyl substituent.

entities.name: Primary aminomethyl product
observations: LiAlH4 reduction of the nitrile gives the corresponding cyclopropylmethylamine, retaining the phenyl groups, ether, and reported cyclopropane stereochemistry; product SMILES: C1(=CC=CC=C1)[C@]1([C@@H](C1)COCC1=CC=CC=C1)CN.
Matching ORD record reports 71% yield at 0 °C for 2 h in diethyl ether.

entities.name: Lithium aluminium hydride
observations: Used as the reducing agent for nitrile-to-primary-amine conversion.

entities.name: Diethyl ether
observations: Reaction solvent; reported conditions 0 °C for 2 h.
